item.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of contradicting US brokered deal

item.title: Dozens of children killed after roof collapses in Pakistani school
item.description: At least 29 people, mostly children, have been killed after the school collapsed on them in Pakistan’s Peshawar.

item.title: Russia says Ukraine resumes attacks on oil refineries
item.description: Ukraine's president earlier said Kyiv was 'done' with energy ceasefire and that strikes on Russian oil refineries would resume.

item.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
item.description: Rescue officials fear more people are buried under the debris in the north-western city of Peshawar.

item.title: Hundreds of IDF investigations into killings still have no public outcome, BBC Verify finds
item.description: BBC Verify has identified 254 incidents from the past three years the Israeli military said it is reviewing after being accused of harm.
